label: preparing
what: An evening community hospitality gathering / feast at the great hall, scheduled for day 1 at 18:00. Evidence includes hall lanterns, builder and innkeeper depositing bread, a 200-loaf catering delivery, and reports that innkeeper and freight identify the gathering. Neighbour appears to have relayed invitations; innkeeper and builder explicitly coordinate it. Freight and baker are knowingly involved through the paid catering order, though the record gives less detail about freight's specific work. The mayor was not told the occasion until after preparations were underway; details were intentionally held for the announcement.
